sn44.3:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahā Koṭṭhiko Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti Isipatane Migadāye || || 2
sn44.3:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Koṭṭhiko sāyaṇhasamayam patisallānā pavuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhim sammodi ||
sn44.3:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahā-Koṭṭhiko āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam etad avoca || ||
sn44.3:2.1: Kiṃ nu kho avuso Sāriputta || hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.3:2.4: Kim panāvuso na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.3:2.6: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 5
sn44.3:2.7: Kiṃ nu kho āvuso hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.3:2.8: Etam pi kho āvuso avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.3:2.9: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || 6
sn44.3:2.10: Kim panāvuso neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti ||
sn44.3:2.11: Etam pi kho āvuso avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.3:2.12: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 7
sn44.3:3.1: Kiṃ nu kho āvuso Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti iti puṭṭho samāno avyākataṃ kho etam āvuso Bhagavatā
sn44.3:3.2: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vadesi || pe || ||
sn44.3:3.3: Kim panāvuso Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.3:3.4: Etam pi kho āvuso avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.3:3.5: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vadesi || ||
sn44.3:3.6: Ko nu kho āvuso hetu ko paccayo yenetam avyākatam Bhagavatā ti || || 8
sn44.3:4.1: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti kho āvuso rūpagatam etaṃ ||
sn44.3:4.2: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti rūpagatam etam ||
sn44.3:4.3: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti rūpagatam etaṃ ||
sn44.3:4.4: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti rūpagatam etaṃ || || 9
sn44.3:4.5: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti kho āvuso vedanāgatam etaṃ ||
sn44.3:4.6: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vedanāgatam etaṃ ||
sn44.3:4.7: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vedanāgatam etam ||
sn44.3:4.8: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vedanāgatam etam || || 10
sn44.3:4.9: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti kho āvuso saññāgatam etaṃ ||
sn44.3:4.10: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti saññāgatam etam || ||
sn44.3:4.11: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti saññāgatam etaṃ ||
sn44.3:4.12: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti saññāgatam etaṃ || || 11
sn44.3:4.13: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti kho āvuso saṅkhāragatam etam ||
sn44.3:4.14: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti saṅkhāragatam etam ||
sn44.3:4.15: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti saṅkhāragatam etaṃ ||
sn44.3:4.16: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti saṅkhāragatam etaṃ || || 12
sn44.3:4.17: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti kho āvuso viññāṇagatam etam ||
sn44.3:4.18: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti viññāṇagatam etam ||
sn44.3:4.19: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti viññāṇagatam etaṃ ||
sn44.3:4.20: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi viññāṇagatam etam || || 13
sn44.3:4.21: Ayaṃ kho āvuso hetu ayam paccayo yena tam avyākatam Bhagavatā
